🔑 NH HB1612 — NH Bill Targets Landlords Using Price-Fixing Software

New Hampshire is considering a law that would make it illegal for landlords to use price-fixing websites, algorithms, or other software to set rental prices.

The bill, if passed, would classify such practices as unfair competition and deceptive acts, violating the state’s Consumer Protection Act.

The Department of Justice would be tasked with investigating complaints about this conduct and enforcing the new rules.

The bill anticipates an increase in investigations, potentially requiring the creation of one additional full-time attorney position at the Department of Justice, with an estimated cost of $72,000 in the first fiscal year.

Aug. 20, 2026: Died on Table, Session ended 08/19/2026  HJ 16.
